title: NamaStay | 30A Escapes
meta_description: BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, direct beach access for this property is temporarily unavailable. Nearby public beach access points remain available for guests to enjoy during their stay. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.
description_expanded: Description Description BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, direct beach access for this property is temporarily unavailable. Nearby public beach access points remain available for guests to enjoy during their stay. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.30A ESCAPES presents…“NamaStay,” where luxury meets laid-back living in Seacrest West. Start your day by your private pool or unwind by the gas fire pit under the stars. Grill in the spacious outdoor kitchen while the kids play in the fenced backyard or explore Scenic Highway 30A with the 7 bikes provided. With 5 luxurious suites and room for up to 12 guests, NamaStay is designed for memorable getaways with family and friends. Ready to experience it? Learn more below...👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Private Seasonally Heated Pool: Relax beside the beautifully designed pool, surrounded by a fenced backyard for added privacy.Outdoor Entertaining: Dine and unwind in a thoughtfully designed outdoor space featuring a gas fire pit, covered outdoor kitchen with a Big Green Egg, gas grill and spacious backyard dining area.7 Bicycles Included: Explore Scenic Highway 30A and the surrounding communities with bikes provided for your stay.Luxurious Accommodations: Enjoy 5 beautifully furnished bedrooms, each with its own En-suite bathroom, including a spacious bunk room with a private balcony.Convenient Seacrest West Location: Enjoy nearby dining, shopping and entertainment in Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach and The Big Chill.Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "The pool was heated so well that steam rose off the water! Perfect family setup." – Andrew K.⭐ "Awesome house with a great pool, fire pit, and outdoor kitchen — plus comfy beds. We’ll be back!" – Jamison H.⭐ "Spacious first-floor primary suite and a glorious private pool — we were thrilled with our stay!" – Nancy R.*** LIVING AREAS ***Step inside a spacious, open-concept home with thoughtfully designed interiors and plenty of room to gather. The first-floor living area features a plush sectional sofa, large flat-screen TV and beautiful views of the private backyard. French doors connect the living room to the outdoor entertaining spaces, making it easy to move between the two. The adjoining kitchen and dining areas provide a welcoming setting for spending time together.Spacious open-concept layout with stylish, comfortable seatingLarge flat-screen Smart TV for entertainmentFrench doors opening to the private backyard and outdoor living areas*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The kitchen at NamaStay is designed for everything from morning coffee to preparing a family dinner. Featuring an oversized center island, stainless steel appliances, gas stove and fully equipped wet bar, it offers plenty of space to cook and entertain. The adjoining dining area seats 6, with additional seating at the island and outdoor dining area.Spacious oversized island with seating for up to 5Gas stove, ice maker and stainless steel appliancesWet bar featuring a mini fridge and sinkIndoor dining table with seating for 6Additional covered outdoor dining table with seating for 6*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Relax and entertain in your own private backyard oasis. Spend sunny afternoons lounging by the pool while the kids enjoy the spacious fenced yard. Fire up the grill for dinner, gather around the gas fire pit in the evening or settle beneath the covered porch to enjoy a movie on the outdoor Smart TV.Private seasonally heated (Sept-April) pool with plenty of poolside seating and sun loungersFully fenced yard for added privacyGas fire pit for relaxing evenings outdoorsCovered outdoor kitchen featuring a Big Green Egg and gas grillCovered outdoor dining area with Smart TV*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***NamaStay features three floors of beautifully furnished accommodations, with five bedrooms offering comfortable spaces for guests to relax and unwind.1st Floor:Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-Suite with dual vanities, soaking tub & walk-in showerPowder Room: Conveniently located off the kitchen2nd Floor:Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, private balcony and En-Suite with dual vanities & walk-in showerFront Queen Guest Suite: Queen bed, private balcony and En-Suite with single vanity & shower/tub combo.Rear Queen Guest Suite: Queen bed and En-Suite with single vanity and walk-in shower.3rd Floor:Bunk Room: Custom-built Queen-over-Queen bunks beds, flat-screen TV, private balcony and En-Suite with single vanity & walk-in shower*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in Seacrest West, NamaStay offers a convenient home base for exploring some of Scenic Highway 30A's most popular communities. Take the provided bikes for a ride through Alys Beach, browse the shops and restaurants in Rosemary Beach or head to The Big Chill for live music, casual dining and family-friendly entertainment.Alys Beach: Known for its beautiful white architecture, scenic green spaces and local diningRosemary Beach: Charming streets, boutique shopping, restaurants and coffee shopsThe Big Chill: A lively gathering spot offering dining, live entertainment and family-friendly activities*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Pool heating is only available between September 1 and April 30.Waiver required to get access to the 7 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSV (Low Speed Vehicles) are NOT allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.There are active cameras on the front porch and on the right side of the house. There is a disconnected (inactive) camera facing the back yard and pool area.*** YOUR STAY – OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 guest support and an immaculate home designed for comfort, connection, and coastal charm.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 102688STRO #: STR-102688 Read less
